---
description: "Use when writing or editing any Python file in the backend or worker. Enforces module structure, docstrings, type hints, layer separation, and file size limits."
applyTo: "{backend,worker,mcp_server}/**/*.py"
---

Before writing or editing this file, read the full standard:
- docs/standards/python_backend_style.md
- docs/standards/architecture_guardrails.md

Those files are the single source of truth for all Python style, docstring format, naming, file size limits, and layer rules.
